description: This Java class 'KeywordIndex' handles indexing of product data for keyword search in the OFBiz framework. It gathers product attributes, features, content, and related data, processes keywords with weights, and stores them for search optimization.

classes.name: KeywordIndex
classes.description: Provides static methods for indexing product data for keyword search, including gathering product attributes, features, content, and related data, processing keywords with weights, and storing them.

methods.name: forceIndexKeywords
methods.description: Forces reindexing of keywords for a product, with doAll flag set to true.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Indexes keywords for a product, with doAll flag set to false.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Main method that performs indexing of product data, gathering attributes, features, content, and related info, processing keywords, and storing them.

methods.name: addWeightedDataResourceString
methods.description: Retrieves content from a data resource and adds it multiple times based on weight for indexing.

methods.name: addWeightedKeywordSourceString
methods.description: Adds a product attribute or feature string to the list multiple times based on its weight.
